content: Yakop ighau
Tauvene Isak ipoi Yakop ilam, ve ighur poia to Maaron izaa tooni, ra aavo iyaryaaŋ pani ighe: “Yo irau uvai Kanaan tinazi eta mako kat.
Uburig ula pa taan sirivu to Mesopotamia, ve ula ruum to timbum Betuel, o uvai wagham Laban natliva eta.
Maaron Saksaki Tau Iliiv Zimaronŋa Tisov na, pale ighur poia tooni izaa tsio, ve igham paaghu tsio tivot timin naol, ve rumei katini tivot ilat tsio.
Poia tooni tau muuŋ izaa to Abaram na, aat izaa tsio ve paaghu tsio paam. Leso taan tau aazne uleep umin loom pani ne, imin lem. Pasaa, taan tane, Maaron ighuru imin timbum Abaram le.”
Isak isavsaav pa Yakop le isov, ra ighuru ila pa Mesopotamia. Leso ileep tomania waagha Laban tau Betuel naatu na. Laban tane, puughu tooni ivot ila to Aram.
Esau ilooŋ tighe Isak ighur poia to Maaron izaa to Yakop, ve ighuru ila pa Mesopotamia, leso ivai ta sewe. Ve aavo iyaryaaŋ pani ighe ivai Kanaan tinazi eta sov.
Esau ighita Yakop itaghon taama ma tiina aliŋazi ve ila pa Mesopotamia,
ra ighilaal ighe Kanaan tinazi ru tau i ivai zi na, taama Isak loolo pazi mako.
Tauvene Esau ipul taama ma tiina, ve ila to taama Ismael, ra ivai livaa ite, eeza Maalat. Maalat liivu eeza Nebaiot. Maalat ve Nebaiot, ene Ismael natŋa.
Yakop vivuuŋ tooni
Yakop iburig, ipul nugh Ber-Seba, ve ighe ila pa nugh Aran.
I ilaagh ila le ivot nugh ee, ve mboŋ izi pani. Tauvene igham maet ee imin ali pani, ve izi igheen.
I iviv, ve ighita gabua ee imin ndeet tau iyooz izi taan, ve izala pa sambam. Ve yes aŋela to Maaron tiyesyes taghoni tizizi ve tizazaa.
Ra ighita Maaron tauu iyooz izi ziige, ve isaav pani ighe: “Yau Yoova. Yau Maaron to timbum Abaram, ve Maaron to Isak. Taan tau yo ugheen pani ne, ene yau aat nagham payo tomania paaghu tsio.

Paaghu tsio pale timasa timin naol imin ŋgaupup to taan, le tirau nugh. Siriv pale tila pa ragh puughu, ve siriv tila pa yavaar puughu, ve siriv tila pa daudau puughu, ve siriv tila pa kaagu puughu. Ve yo tomania paaghu tsio pale amin eez to poia tsiau izaa to nughmariŋ to taan.

Ulooŋ. Nugh sindei tau yo ula uleep pani, ene yau aat naleep tomani ghom ve matag payo. Ve murei, yau pale nagham ghom umuul ulam pa taan tane. Tauvene yau irau napul ghom mako. Pale naleep tomani ghom le nagham saveeŋ mbuaaŋ tsiau tane anooŋa ivot payo.”
Ra Yakop iburig maata iyaryaar, ve isaav pa tauu ighe: “Wai, onoon kat, Yoova ileep izi nugh tane, ve yau nawataghi mako.”
Tauvene roiŋ tiina ighamu, ve isaav ighe: “Yau naroi kat. Pasaa, nugh tane patabuyaaŋ! Onoon kat, ene Maaron tauu niia. Ataman to nugh sambam igheen ta sene.”
Yakop izi igheen muul le nughizau. Ra iburig, igham maet tau iyalia imin ali na, ve ipayooze imin ilaal pa nugh tawe, ve iliŋ ŋgoreeŋ izala paavo.
I iwaat nugh tana eeza Betel.
Muuŋ, nugh tana eeza Lus.

Ra Yakop imbu saveeŋ ariaaŋ ila loolo tauvene: “Isaav ighe Maaron ileep tomani ghau, ve maata payau pa laghooŋ tsiau tane, ve igham leg aniiŋ toman nonoghiiŋa to nanonogh ghau pani, ve isaav ighe naleep poia mon le irau namuul nala pa ruum to tamaŋ, ene aat Yoova imin Maaron tsiau, ve nabees pani.

Maet tau napayooze ne, pale itotoi ighe nugh tane, ene Maaron niia.” Ra imbu saveeŋ tomania Maaron ighe: “Onoon kat, gabua naol isov tau yo ugham payau na, yau aat navalagh zi timin ŋgun saŋavul, ve naghur ŋgun ee ilat payo.”
